policy: Human taste and explicit acceptance govern; progress is evidence, not arbitrary XP.

branches.name: Mouth and Pocket
branches.goal: Stress, breath, triplets, rhyme elasticity, silence

branches.name: Sonic Misdirection
branches.goal: Album sound, feint drops, legato, motifs

branches.name: Evidence and Learning
branches.goal: Accurate listening labels, A/B, creator authority

nodes.name: Source and scene custody
nodes.exercise: Separate authored draft, outside critique, and listener perception.
nodes.evidence_test: Source snapshots remain verbatim with origin labels.

nodes.name: Full scene loadout
nodes.exercise: Define trio POV, map/POI/mode, two weapons, ammo, heals, armor, ordnance, abilities, ring and exit.
nodes.evidence_test: At least three loadout details produce actual tactical consequences.

nodes.name: Tactical causal chain
nodes.exercise: Trace cue, competing readings, decision, counterplay, cost and result.
nodes.evidence_test: What occurred is plausible and understandable from action.

nodes.name: Accumulated expressive wisdom
nodes.exercise: Reframe an old failure as a present skill and teammate-led insight.
nodes.evidence_test: Growth is demonstrated, not asserted as invincibility.

nodes.name: Semantic compression
nodes.exercise: Express a specific flaw through a concise contrast then demonstrate it.
nodes.evidence_test: Punchline conveys more than a generic boast.

nodes.name: Extended metaphor grammar
nodes.exercise: Map three grammar, finance or spatial terms onto distinct actions.
nodes.evidence_test: Every metaphor makes an action more intelligible.

nodes.name: Productive phonetic ambiguity
nodes.exercise: Preserve written can see and listener-heard concede as separate readings.
nodes.evidence_test: New meaning explored without altering original words.

nodes.name: Foreshadowing and delayed payoff
nodes.exercise: Plant tiny cues early and alter their meaning later.
nodes.evidence_test: Callback changes understanding instead of repeating sound.

nodes.name: Ironic recontextualization
nodes.exercise: Let a coach ask why enemies conceded, only to discover squad already wiped them.
nodes.evidence_test: Reveal is funny through new information and timing, not surrender.

nodes.name: Vocal stress and mouthfeel
nodes.exercise: Mark accented syllables, plosives and connected-speech variants.
nodes.evidence_test: Speak naturally and articulate important words.

nodes.name: Breath and subdivisions
nodes.exercise: Place longer text across beat groups with real resets.
nodes.evidence_test: No unsustainable one-bar claims from syllable counts alone.

nodes.name: Laid-back to rapid pocket
nodes.exercise: Contrast loose swagger, triplet pickups and compact fast bursts.
nodes.evidence_test: Speed expresses a changing decision while lyrics remain clear.

nodes.name: Functional rhyme elasticity
nodes.exercise: Compare perfect rhyme, slant and syntactically clean endings.
nodes.evidence_test: Meaning and musicality outrank blanket AABB enforcement.

nodes.name: Punchline silence
nodes.exercise: Try drop-and-return timing around a delayed reveal.
nodes.evidence_test: Rest makes punchline perceptible without losing pulse.

nodes.name: Distinct POV voices
nodes.exercise: Give narrator and each squadmate a unique tactical goal and diction.
nodes.evidence_test: Voices recognizable by decision rather than name tags.

nodes.name: Coach through comms
nodes.exercise: Replace a leadership lecture with a question and an executed response.
nodes.evidence_test: Learning shown through tactical action, not sermon.

nodes.name: Distributed team competence
nodes.exercise: Give teammates valid partial reads that combine into a win.
nodes.evidence_test: No single narrator is all-knowing.

nodes.name: Mentor authority reversal
nodes.exercise: Let mentee identify the decisive read first.
nodes.evidence_test: Narrator yields credit in a credible dramatic moment.

nodes.name: Sound signature with variation
nodes.exercise: Distinguish core Southern trap/drill identity from track-specific sonic treatments.
nodes.evidence_test: Tracks belong together without identical production prompts.

nodes.name: Moist decoy drop
nodes.exercise: Build feint, silence, unexpected lyric, returning gliding 808.
nodes.evidence_test: Drop solves story or humor, not arbitrary bar-count fashion.

nodes.name: Crooning as consequence
nodes.exercise: Place warm brash legato against clipped rap at an emotional pivot.
nodes.evidence_test: Sung shift earns meaning and preserves diction.

nodes.name: Cross-track motif evolution
nodes.exercise: Reharmonize or rhythmically shift two taps and blue ping in final tracks.
nodes.evidence_test: Listeners discover changed significance.

nodes.name: Evidence state honesty
nodes.exercise: Distinguish written draft, proposed prompt, audio render, listening report, approved material.
nodes.evidence_test: Never treat lyrics-on-page as heard audio.

nodes.name: Heard Differently ledger
nodes.exercise: Capture exact user-heard words, original and their interpretations.
nodes.evidence_test: No silent overwrite; unexpected meaning preserved.

nodes.name: Controlled A/B
nodes.exercise: Change one test dimension; record model/settings and generation variation.
nodes.evidence_test: Comparisons disclose confounds and actual listening observations.

nodes.name: Human artistic approval
nodes.exercise: Present alternative branches and supported evidence before final decision.
nodes.evidence_test: Explicit creator approval only, no auto-canon or metrics leak.
